thread:
meera: Quick thread to finalize DR follow-ups. Extracted 6 actionable items from the postmortem. Need owners, minimal acceptance criteria, and a short test window.
jon: I can own the routing validation + safe flip script. Deliverable: script + README + sample perf CSV. Plan a sandbox sim next Tue.
carl: I'll handle backups + retention fixes and the restore runbook. Will run a restore in staging and paste exact steps here.
sanjeev: I'll coordinate the game-day and volunteer run-of-show. Propose Fri 10:00 PT (2h window). Any blockers?
jon: Routing test modes: region outage, AZ networking blip, and slow peer; script supports `--dry-run/--measure/--execute`. I will capture RTO, error-rate, and 95th latency.
carl: Minimal restore steps (short):
```
- confirm snapshot exists: `gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="labels.env=prod" --limit=1`
- create dr namespace: `kubectl --context=dr-test create ns dr-smoke`
- restore DB: `pg_restore --dbname=dr_test_db latest.dump`
- smoke: `curl -fsS http://dr-smoke.app/healthz`
- sample verify: `python tools/sample_check.py --n=5`
```
meera: Add explicit IAM/service-account names to runbook so volunteers aren't blocked. Also include rollback thresholds.
sanjeev: Draft run-of-show items: pre-notify #incidents 24h prior, snapshot IAM check, routing sim (jon), cache rehydration check (post-flip), smoke tests (carl), retro + artifacts.
jon: Cache rehydration check: sample 12 keys starting 5m post-flip, run 10m; fail if miss rate > 8%. Will emit CSV + small graph.
carl: Found a retention gap: `redwood-prod-snapshots` had 14d retention for one project. I'll open infra ticket to extend to 90d and add daily incrementals.
meera: Owners + quick deadlines:
- routing script + audit -> jon -> due 2175600000
- backups retention ticket + runbook -> carl -> due 2175450000
- game-day coordination + invites -> sanjeev -> due 2175350000
- IAM precheck doc -> carl -> due 2175320000
- post-game-day retro -> all -> due 2175800000
jon: Safety guards on the flip script: built-in `--abort-on-errors` and a `--max-error-rate` flag. Will default to `--dry-run` unless `--execute` passed by owner.
sanjeev: Add a visible abort threshold in the playbook: if any phase reports >20% error-rate or DB checksum mismatch >0 then abort and page on-call.
ops-bot: reminder: tag artifacts with `incident:DR-2026` and post results to the incident tracker automatically.
carl: Acceptance criteria (minimal):
- restore run: app `/healthz` within 30m of restore start and sample check returns 0 mismatches;
- routing test: scripted flip completes and measured RTO < 5m for full region failover in sandbox;
- cache: post-flip miss rate <= 8% within 10m.
jeon: (typo) ignore
meera: I'll create the action-tracker card and assign P0 to routing + restore doc. Please attach artifacts (logs, perf graphs, CSVs) to the card after tests. If anyone needs creds or quota bumps, shout here. :thumbsup:
jon: I'll post the first sandbox CSV and a short README after tomorrow's sim.
carl: I'll open the retention ticket and start the runbook PR tonight.
sanjeev: I'll lock the calendar slot after quick EU on-call check and publish the run-of-show.
meera: Closing note: primary goal is a compact, repeatable playbook with clear owners, measurable pass/fail criteria, and a <2hr initial verification SLA during drills. We'll reconvene after retro. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
